answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in sonnet, expire in nadir, and gale lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 177 aliases as a result needs 130 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 38 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
